description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ByteDance is a technology company developing products and platforms that inspire creativity and enrich life. The PICO Developer Technology team is seeking a graduate engineer to develop and optimize XR graphics features, system software, and performance tools, while organizing research data and producing technical reports and papers.
XR graphics engineer developing system software, performance tools, and publishing graphics research

Responsibilities:
• Develop innovative and highly performanced XR graphics features
• Develop PICO XR system software
• Graphics and performance tool development
• Organize research data, write technical reports, and publish research papers

Requirements:
• Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in computer science or a related discipline
• 3D graphics rendering experience
• Good understanding of modern mobile graphics pipeline
• Good understanding of Vulkan or OpenGL
• Strong C++ programming skills
• Strong optimization skill to ship practical technologies into products

Preferred:
• Papers published at CVPR, SIGGRAPH and other top conferences/journals
• Familiar with Qualcomm SOC and low level GPU profiling library
